description: Businesses listed on Google Maps for 1-5 categories in an area (city, postal code, country, or coordinates with a radius), with optional lead filters: no website, unclaimed profile, rating below a value, fewer reviews than a value, or first listed in the last N days. Returns name, category, address, coordinates, Google Maps link and place_id, website, claimed flag, rating, review count, status and first-seen date. Phone numbers are not returned. Billed per business returned plus a run start fee.

categories.description: 1-5 Google Maps categories, e.g. plumber, dentist, roofing contractor, restaurant.

city.description: City as written in addresses, e.g. Austin. Use with country_code.

coordinates.description: Search around a point "lat,lng", e.g. 30.2672,-97.7431. Use with radius_km.

country_code.description: 2-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, GB, CA. Can be used alone for a country-wide list.

first_seen_within_days.description: Only listings first found by the data provider in the last N days (not the opening date).

limit.description: Businesses to return (default 20, max 50). Billed per business returned.

min_rating.description: Only businesses rated at least this.

min_reviews.description: Only businesses with at least this many reviews.

rating_below.description: Only businesses rated strictly below this, e.g. 4.

reviews_below.description: Only businesses with fewer reviews than this (zero-review businesses included).

sort_by.description: Order when more businesses match than the limit (default most_reviews).

unclaimed_only.description: Only businesses whose Google profile is unclaimed (default false).

name: find_local_businesses
title: Find local businesses (Google Maps)
